verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad set of REST APIs (Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Payments, Transactions, Team, Webhooks), a quickstart, Postman, low-code integrations (Pipedream, Zapier), and an MCP server. However, nothing in the evidence mentions official language SDKs or client libraries. Since an official-SDK story is a fair question for an API platform, the absence of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".
